name: Nigerian Rice and Beans Jollof
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or palm oil

steps: Rinse the beans, and boil in water until tender. Drain the cooked beans.
Grind together the chiles, tomatoes, and onions to make a purée.
Heat a thin layer of oil in a pan, and add the purée. Season with stock cube and salt, and simmer for 3 minutes.
Stir in the parboiled rice and beans, and cook for 5 minutes.
Serve with beef, chicken, or moin-moin.

culture.text: Rice and beans jollof is a typical Nigerian food made from rice and beans. It is served with beef, chicken or moin moin.
